findings.evidence: Template line 13: "replace each `…` below with `changed`, `checked`, `declined` or `n/a`, a dash, and a note".
findings.fix: Rewrite each line in the template's format, e.g. `- Q1 Mathlib duplicates: checked — …`. The format is in `.github/pull_request_template.md`. An edit to the description alone starts no new review, so reply on this thread once the description is updated.
findings.issue: No Q1–Q5 line begins with a status word. Each opens with prose, e.g. "Q1: reuse checked against pinned Mathlib exterior-power/product APIs." and "Q4: native instance/universe and section-variable checks pass…". The template's line labels ("Q1 Mathlib duplicates:" etc.) are also missing.

findings.evidence: Template Q2: "Tau Ceti must not already have the same object or lemma, on main or in an open PR … This includes every `private` declaration … The note says what you looked for."
findings.fix: Write the line as `checked — …` or `changed — …`, naming what was looked for on main and in open PRs, including the private helpers. Description-only edit: reply on this thread once updated.
findings.issue: The Q2 note ("native bundle determinant and tensor APIs reused; existing operator determinant laws supply the algebraic coherence") lists what was reused, not what was searched for. It does not say whether main and open PRs were checked for an existing Whitney/determinant-product comparison, or for the private helpers (`coe_exteriorPower_apply`, `coe_degree_zero`, `fiberDetLineEquiv`, `pullbackPointLinearEquiv`).

findings.evidence: Template Q3: "Each ends in one of four states … The note says what was dropped or derived, with the counterexample for each one kept." The diff has `variable [CompleteSpace K]` before `chartCoord_prodEquiv_tmul`, with `omit [CompleteSpace K]` only on selected later theorems.
findings.fix: For each hypothesis, say whether it was dropped, derived, needed to state, or kept with a counterexample. Any you cannot settle go on a line beginning `declined`. Description-only edit: reply on this thread once updated.
findings.issue: The Q3 note only lists premises that were *not* added ("no positive-rank, nonempty-base, … premise is introduced"). It says nothing about the hypotheses the theorems do carry. For example, `[CompleteSpace K]` is kept on `chartCoord_prodEquiv_tmul`, `prodEquiv_inCoordinates`, `continuous_prodEquiv` and `chartCoord_pullback_prodEquiv_tmul`, but omitted elsewhere. The per-fibre `TopologicalSpace`/`IsModuleTopology` tensor instances and `[FiniteDimensional K F₁]` are also kept without comment.

summary: The Quality pass block has five lines, but none begins with `changed`, `checked`, `declined` or `n/a` as the template requires. The Q2 note does not say whether open PRs were searched, and the Q3 note neither states what happened to each hypothesis nor gives counterexamples.
